description: 兵引离后钩杀：吃兵将军驱王，车踏g8将死
explanation_en: A pawn capture with check deflects the king, allowing the rook to deliver hook mate on g8.

intro.popup: 💡 引离钩杀：白车在h8，白马在f6，白兵在f4，白王在g4——如何先将军引走黑王，再钩杀？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Deflection into a hook mate: White's rook is on h8, knight on f6, pawn on f4, and king on g4. How can White check and deflect the black king before mating?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：fxg5+兵将军引王离开h6，Rg8#车马兵王构成钩形将死——白王在g4也是钩杀拼图的一部分！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: fxg5+ deflects the king from h6. Rg8# then completes a hook made by White's rook, knight, pawn, and king; White's king on g4 also helps control the escape squares.

moves.popup: 白兵fxg5+将军！兵吃掉g5黑兵，新兵在g5攻击h6，逼迫黑王离开h6。
moves.popup_en: fxg5+! The pawn captures Black's pawn on g5 and checks, attacking h6 and forcing the black king away.

moves.popup: 黑王逃往g6——正中白方下怀！
moves.popup_en: The black king moves to g6, exactly where White wants it.

moves.popup: 白车Rg8#钩杀！车从h8到g8沿g列将军，马守h5/h7/f7/f5，兵守h6，白王封f5——黑王g6四面被钩！
moves.popup_en: Rg8# delivers hook mate! The rook checks along the g-file, while the knight, pawn, and White's king cover the escape squares around the black king on g6.
